description: Add API version discovery and normalized read-only access to system status, root folders, download clients, quality profiles, and queue summaries using synthetic responses.
acceptance: Unsupported API versions fail with a typed blocker.
Secrets and request headers are redacted from all output.
Synthetic fixtures prove normalized capability and configuration output.
The adapter reuses transport-01 for endpoint policy, credentials, retries, typed failures, and redaction rather than implementing a private HTTP stack.
Fast synthetic fixture tests and a focused real-container radarr lane both pass.
Read-only operation performs no domain mutation; any required authentication session is explicitly classified and side-effect-free.
